msg: Gnomes always appear in the same pairs. Orange/Brown, Red/Yellow, Green/Pink, and Blue/Purple. Orange, red, green, and blue send you to the bright forest. Brown, pink, yellow, and purple send you to the dark forest. I tried to establish which location had the better mushroom harvest by exploring and I would check if I should switch when I only 2-3 mushrooms from a harvest. I feel I may have somewhat preferred the dark forest and clicked on brown, pink, yellow, and purple gnomes more frequently, but I still had stretches where I chose the bright forest colors. Be willing to change your selection to test.
